title: Arcade Gears Vol. 3: Wonder 3
native_title: ＡＧアーケード・ギアーズ ワンダー３
overview:
Three varied games - action, shooting and puzzle - all in one!!

This disc brings three arcade games together, each playable alone or with a second player who can jump in at any time.

- Roosters: an action platformer. The villain Gaia has stolen the Chariot of Light and is turning people into wooden statues, so Lou and Siva run, jump, dash and shoot through each stage to stop him and save their friend Sena.
- Chariot: a horizontally scrolling shooter that continues the story. Lou and Siva ride the Chariots of Light through the skies to rescue a kidnapped princess, firing wide or rapid shots and swinging a flexible tail of weapon pods.
- Donpuru: a maze puzzle game. As Don-kun the rabbit or Pull-kun the squirrel, push blocks to squash every monster in each round.
- Comes with a strategy guide written by Gamest staff

アクション・シューティング・パズルと、バラエティ豊かな3つのゲームが1つになった！！
